description: This file defines the Dispatcher class and related classes for managing test execution, worker processes, and test result reporting in a test runner framework, specifically for Playwright's test infrastructure.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages test execution, worker pool, and reporting for Playwright tests.

classes.name: JobDispatcher
classes.description: Handles individual test group execution, test lifecycle events, and retries.

methods.name: _findFirstJobToRun
methods.description: Finds the first test group in the queue that can be scheduled based on worker limits.

methods.name: _scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the next test group to run if resources are available.

methods.name: _runJobInWorker
methods.description: Runs a test group in a specific worker process, handling worker lifecycle and test execution.

methods.name: _checkFinished
methods.description: Checks if all tests and workers have completed, resolving the finish promise.

methods.name: _isWorkerRedundant
methods.description: Determines if a worker is redundant based on its hash and queued/running count.

methods.name: _updateCounterForWorkerHash
methods.description: Updates the count of queued or running workers with a specific hash.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts executing a list of test groups with environment setup.

methods.name: producedEnvByProjectId
methods.description: Returns environment variables produced by workers, grouped by project ID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all workers and halts test execution.

methods.name: runInWorker
methods.description: Initiates test execution in a specific worker process.

methods.name: _onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the event when a test begins.

methods.name: _onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the event when a test ends, recording results and failures.

methods.name: _addNonretriableTestAndSerialModeParents
methods.description: Marks tests and their serial mode parents as non-retriable failures.

methods.name: _onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step.

methods.name: _onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, recording duration and errors.

methods.name: _onAttach
methods.description: Handles attachment of files or data to a test.

methods.name: _failTestWithErrors
methods.description: Marks a test as failed with specific errors.

methods.name: _massSkipTestsFromRemaining
methods.description: Skips remaining tests, marking them as skipped or failed.

methods.name: _onDone
methods.description: Handles completion of a test group, including retries and failures.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Handles unexpected worker process exit.

methods.name: _finished
methods.description: Resolves the finish promise with test run result.

methods.name: chunkFromParams
methods.description: Converts test output payload to string or Buffer.
